errors.evidence: The machine-generated description incorrectly translates the x-axis label '外部机器翻译数据规模' (External machine translation data scale) as '外部分類器翻译数量' (number of external classifier translations).
The x-axis starts from 0M, not 1M. The description omits the first data point.
The y-axis is labeled 'BLEU' without specifying any units. Stating the unit is percentage is an assumption not present in the figure.
The line plot clearly has circular markers at each of the five data points.

errors.text_span: 从 x 轴的 1M 处开始
errors.evidence: The line starts at the x-axis value of 0M, not 1M.

errors.text_span: 在 x 轴的 1M 处对应着 27.00 的 BLEU 评分
errors.evidence: At 1M on the x-axis, the corresponding BLEU score is approximately 27.3, not 27.00.

errors.text_span: 在 x 轴的 4M 处为 29.00 的 BLEU 评分
errors.evidence: At 4M on the x-axis, the corresponding BLEU score is approximately 29.2, which is visibly above the 29.00 gridline.
The description completely omits the data point at x=0M, which has a BLEU score of approximately 26.7.
